ModMetaData.name: RimExodus: Delta-V (Dev)
ModMetaData.author: Laurence-042
ModMetaData.description:
阶段2 开发原型：基础驾驶。每艘飞船是一张独立的口袋地图，飞船姿态保存在地图外的统一宇宙坐标系中；当前聚焦地图保持原版朝向，非聚焦飞船以可平移、可任意角旋转的外壳代理显示。阶段2 加入连续驾驶（W/S 推进、A/D 平移、Q/E 转向，可在原版改键界面修改）、按质心与推进器位置的刚体物理、飞行辅助与 Universe Layer 星球 tile 映射。
目前正式玩法仍以开发者模式调试入口为主（Dev mode → Debug actions → Delta-V）。
Phase 2 prototype: basic piloting. Each ship is an independent pocket map; poses live in a continuous universe frame outside any map, the focused map keeps vanilla orientation, and non-focused ships show as translatable / freely rotating shell proxies. Phase 2 adds continuous piloting (W/S thrust, A/D strafe, Q/E turn; rebindable in vanilla controls), rigid-body physics with center of mass and thruster positions, flight assist, and the Universe Layer planet-tile mapping.
